# Emhergence

> Emhergence is a living identity infrastructure — it turns what you already know into a decision, a decision into positioning, and positioning into leverage you can actually use.

Founded by Josette Williams. Based in Surrey, British Columbia, Canada.

## Core pages

- [Emhergence](https://emhergence.com/): The hub. Organization record and canonical entry point.
- [Glossary](https://emhergence.com/glossary): Twelve defined terms with dated definitions.
- [About](https://emhergence.com/about): What Emhergence is and who it is built for.
- [FAQ](https://emhergence.com/faq): Eight questions answered in the founder's own language.
